summary.whatChanges: In the tRPC WebSocket adapter, a failed subscription now removes its entry from the per-connection subscription map before the error is reported, matching the cleanup already done on successful completion.
behaviorChanges: Subscription IDs are released when a subscription errors, so the same ID can be reused by the client without colliding with a stale entry
Per-connection subscription tracking no longer accumulates entries for subscriptions that failed, reducing leaked state on long-lived sockets
Connection close/cleanup no longer attempts to tear down subscriptions that already ended in error
risks: Deleting before onError/respond means handlers observing subscription state during the error callback now see the ID already removed
If the map entry could have been replaced by a newer subscription with the same ID, the delete could remove the wrong (newer) entry
